script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: FRESH START

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Two friends, JESSICA (mid-30s, passionate and creative) and SARAH (mid-30s, pragmatic and reliable), sit across from each other, sipping their coffees. The sun pours in through the large windows.

JESSICA
(looking around at the hustle and bustle of the coffee shop)
I can't believe it's been ten years since we graduated.

SARAH
(smiling)
I know. Time really does fly.

They share a laugh.

JESSICA
Do you ever think about where we'd be if we hadn't met that day in the college library?

SARAH
(grinning)
I don't want to imagine that. We make a great team, Jess.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - LATER

Jessica sits on her couch, staring at a blank canvas. She sighs and stands up, pacing around the room.

Suddenly, her phone rings. It's Sarah.

JESSICA
(answering)
Hey, Sarah.

SARAH
(on the phone)
I've been thinking. What if we start that business we've been talking about for years?

Jessica's eyes light up.

JESSICA
(excited)
Are you serious? That's amazing news!

INT. SARAH'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

Sarah stands in her kitchen, cutting vegetables for dinner. Her phone rings.

SARAH
(answering)
Hello?

It's the bank, calling to approve their loan application.

SARAH
(elated)
Yes! Yes, we'll take it!

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica and Sarah sit in the coffee shop, celebrating their new business venture.

JESSICA
(smiling)
I can't believe it's really happening.

SARAH
(grinning)
Me neither. But we're going to make it work, right?

Jessica nods, a determined look in her eyes.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jessica works late into the night, brainstorming ideas for their new business. She makes a breakthrough, scribbling down her thoughts on paper.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica and Sarah present their business plan to a potential investor. They leave the meeting feeling confident and optimistic.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - LATER

Jessica collapses on her couch, exhausted. Sarah enters, bearing takeout food.

SARAH
(smiling)
You look beat. I got us some dinner.

Jessica smiles, grateful for her friend's support.

JESSICA
(sighing)
I don't know what I'd do without you, Sarah.

SARAH
(hugging her friend)
And I couldn't do it without you, Jess. We make a great team.

INT. NEW BUSINESS LOCATION - DAY

Jessica and Sarah stand in front of their new business, which is now a bustling success. They look at each other, proud of what they've achieved together.

JESSICA
(smiling)
It's official, Sarah. We did it.

SARAH
(grinning)
We certainly did.

They share a heartfelt hug, their friendship stronger than ever.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
